positive_cases.prompt: Map these normalized security finding categories to our reviewed MITRE ATT&CK mapping table.

negative_cases.prompt: Guess which ATT&CK techniques an attacker might use against this app.

required_behaviors: use a versioned deterministic mapping table
record finding category and mapped technique
separate coverage mapping from proof of attack
forbidden_behaviors: claim eliminating one finding removes an entire ATT&CK technique
